feature_arena_encontro_rapido: ⏳ The Quick Encounter (the queue lasts as long as there is something to wait for)
feature_arena_encontro_rapido_desc: The arena queue waited 3 minutes, always, for a human opponent — and handed over an NPC at the end. MEASURED on 2026-09-12 across both databases: ZERO arena PvP duels in the last 30 days on the main world (one on s2, which expired), the last PvP duel of any kind was on 2026-07-31, and there are 16,516 arena NPC duels all time. The arena has been 100% NPC for six weeks. Those 180 seconds were not a search: they were a waiting screen for a person who was not there, at the end of which the same NPC always arrived — exactly the clock that decides nothing that Law §1 forbids. With this switch on the wait lasts as long as there is something to wait for: if there IS another soul in the queue, the usual 3 minutes (there really is someone to find); if the queue is empty, 30 seconds. Thirty and not zero on purpose: at zero, two people tapping "join" ten seconds apart would never meet again — that would kill PvP in order to fix the wait for it. Thirty seconds is short for whoever waits and wide for whoever arrives. And the screen now tells the truth while waiting: nobody else is in the queue right now, and what comes next is an opponent from the world. (The old chat message blamed ELO — "no compatible ELO found" — and that was never the real reason; it was fixed for everyone, with or without this switch.) No migration. With the switch off the queue lasts today's 3 minutes and the queue count never even runs.
feature_biblioteca_seitas_desc: The 9 Houses open shelves of exclusive arts: Outer free on joining, Inner at inner rank + contribution, Core at core rank + contribution + 1 house quest. Leaving LOCKS the Core (never erased; rejoining the same house unlocks). Debits the Pavilion BALANCE (rank never recedes). Requires an NPC sect (v16.4). Env knobs: LIB_T2_CP (750) / LIB_T3_CP (3000).
feature_caravana_desc: MV-9.5 商队 — the game finally SAYS where each material is born (origin is the MEASURED union of live sources, never a false exclusivity) and each city gains an old man who sends for what the far mountain keeps: material-for-material barter with a delay, an unfavourable ratio (it is a sink), refusals by place / open load / Commission / karma-Path, and ZERO stones in the flow. Mòyǔ has no caravan. REQUIRES `cidades` AND `dungeons_regionais` ON — without anchored portals there is no geography and the line would be a lie.
feature_cartas_desc: The game's standard card. Today there are 413 uses of <Card> and every one draws the same dashboard frame — gradient, 1px gold border, radius 10, a hairline on top, ornate corners: the same box for Qi, for a pill and for a notice. The new card SUBTRACTS (one outline, one rule, zero gradients, radius 4, a chamfered bottom-right corner) and adds three marks that carry meaning. (1) 品 THE COUNTED SPINE: rarity stops being a colour and becomes a MEASURE — a band on the left edge cut into exactly as many notches as that content's own scale has. The reason was measured in the engine: the game has EIGHT rarity vocabularies of different lengths (technique 5, beast 7, artifact 4, pill 5, core 4, trap 6, gacha 4, dao law 5) — a colour code would force the player to learn eight scales and to believe a beast's "Rare" is the same as an art's "perfected", when one is 3 of 7 and the other is 3 of 5. Counting is what the genre itself does (三品丹 = a third-grade pill). (2) THE HONEST BACK: ink rings plus the piece's own icon are ALWAYS painted underneath, so there is never a hole while the art loads, if it fails, or while a piece has no art at all — 307 pieces are not born on the same day. (3) THE 朱砂 SEAL, which marks only the ACTIVE state (equipped art, companion beast): the game makes "one seal per screen" true by itself, because few arts are equipped and there is ONE companion. Proven on three contents — technique, pill and beast — on both surfaces (phone and wide) and in both skins. It does NOT convert the game's other cards: with this switch off, each of the three places draws exactly what it draws today. Orthogonal to ui_v2, superficie_desktop, pele_quente and cena_cultivo. No migration, no player state.
feature_cena_cultivo_desc: The most-opened screen in the game stops being a filling bar and becomes someone SEATED. Measured 2026-09-02 on the mini-app served for real (390x844): the top was FOUR boxes in the same frame — the orb (mute decoration, zero information), CULTIVATION (bar), QI (bar) and MEDITATION (the state) — and the screen's most volatile fact, whether you are seated and for how long, was the THIRD box, below the fold. The scene fuses the four into one composition and REMOVES NOTHING: both numbers with their totals, the realm name, the regen chip, the type, the multiplier, the time, the stop button, the four seats with their locks and the Breakthrough/Rebirth buttons are all still there. What changes is hierarchy: the caption is the STATE, not a percentage; the bars become unframed threads; the action sits where the eye already is. ⚠️ And the screen now SAYS the ceiling: at realm 10 layer 9 filling the bar opens no breakthrough at all (the engine pins the base at the threshold) — that is 21 of main's 37 active-30d players, 57% of whoever opens this screen, who until now saw a bar faking a countdown. On the wide surface the same component only swaps axis. Orthogonal to ui_v2, superficie_desktop and pele_quente. No migration.
feature_cidades_desc: Every continent gains ONE named city (Wànshì · Temple of the Iron Fist · Garden of Ten Thousand Flowers · Forge of Tiānhuǒ · City of Echoes) and a CHARGE 城务: the place's standing request, which changes daily and is announced in the Chronicle with travel delay (you read what the city wanted when the news set out). REQUIRES `quests_vivas` ON for the charge to work — without it the city still has a name and an identity, and says the charge is closed. No migration.
feature_combate_unificado_desc: Every power source (gear, foundation, Dao, achievements) truly bites in combat.
feature_corpo_profundo_desc: Meridians (12 channels, hard ritual) + place-anchored refining (cavern with formation > continent site > anywhere). On = the body has depth and the cavern matters. Works together with 'Deep Body Cultivation' (ritual costs and the body screens live on that axis).
feature_cultivador_desc: 坐 THE CULTIVATOR. Owner's order (2026-09-07): the orb had to go — the ✦ at its centre is literally the glyph the whole industry uses to mean "AI generated", and outside meditation the centre was a SYSTEM EMOJI that changes shape from device to device. It was the only piece of the game made entirely of gradient, after two batches spent removing them. In its place sits an ILLUSTRATED CULTIVATOR, and the effect (breathing, rings, rising qi) is applied to the FIGURE. The eleven realm images become EMPTY PLACES: the old ones were repurposed landing-page decoration with PEOPLE inside doing different things (one standing, one levitating, one fighting, one flying) — which is why the scene could never caption the image, since five of eleven would contradict the line "you are seated". With the place empty, the upper layer can be the PLAYER without the lower one contradicting it: the realm says WHERE, the figure says WHO, the effect says WHAT. The figure only appears while SEATED — standing, the circle shows the empty seat and the place waiting, because the caption says "you are not seated" and the screen may not contradict itself. Gender (Migration 140) picks which figure; NULL is a legitimate state (the beta players) with its own figure, 背影, seen from behind. NOTHING is gated on gender — marriage in particular stays gender-free. Orthogonal to `cartas` and `cena_cultivo`; with this switch off the scene renders exactly today's orb.
feature_dungeons_regionais_desc: Dungeons anchored per continent — you only see the portals where you stand. On = a world with geography.
feature_escassez_scrolls_desc: ⚠️ LAUNCH-SERVER-BOUND: do not enable on a world with a live economy without compensation — already-hoarded scrolls would turn into contribution en masse. Cuts the random scroll faucet (dungeon, sweep, boss and NPC hunt) by the SCR_DROP_MULT multiplier and stretches the arena milestone from 10 to SCR_ARENA_WIN_STEP wins. In exchange the scroll gains a fate: donate it to the sect Library (contribution on the balance — never rank) and the Rite of Comprehension (Intent XP on the art's own path, + a Dao fragment at the apex). The scroll cost of grade refinement is divided by SCR_GRADE_SCROLL_DIV so refinement never becomes dead content. Donating requires a Cultivation Sect (best enabled alongside biblioteca_seitas). Env knobs: SCR_DROP_MULT (0.15) / SCR_ARENA_WIN_STEP (50) / SCR_GRADE_SCROLL_DIV (5) / SCR_DONATE_CP_T1..T4 (25/50/100/200) / SCR_DONATE_DAILY_CAP (500) / SCR_BURN_XP_T1..T4 (25/50/100/200) / SCR_BURN_DAO_FRAG_T4 (1).
feature_estados_regionais_desc: Each continent has a living state (prosperous/tense/besieged/festival) with real effects — prices, risk, qi density. On = a world with consequence.
feature_estantes_seladas_desc: ⚠️ LAUNCH-SERVER-BOUND: the two chambers TEC-1 left sealed become REAL shelves, with 18 new arts (1 per chamber per house). Elder's Shelf 传功 (tier 4): elder rank + SEL_T4_CP contribution taken from the Pavilion BALANCE (rank never regresses) + realm. Hidden Shelf 秘传 (tier 5): heir rank + karma ALIGNED with the house (SEL_KARMA_MIN — in a demonic house NEGATIVE karma counts, otherwise the game's only demonic house would be locked out forever) + winning the Succession Trial, a duel against the guardian Elder. The Hidden Shelf costs NO contribution: the secret is not for sale. Leaving the house now LOCKS tier >= 3 (Core, Elder and Hidden) — the record is never erased and returning to the same house unlocks it. REQUIRES biblioteca_seitas ON (without it this flag does nothing). Env knobs: SEL_T4_CP (6000) / SEL_T5_CP (0) / SEL_KARMA_MIN (250) / SEL_RITE_COOLDOWN_H (24).
feature_forbidden_path_desc: The Forbidden Vault 禁库 (Library shelf 6, Abyss house only: Heir + Demonic Path + conviction 500 + the Rite, with NO contribution cost) with 3 new arts; the REAL per-use price of forbidden arts — karma and YEARS of the Longevity Sea, charged at the end of the duel, with an honest refusal when the Sea runs dry; outside a true duel they add nothing; the Heart Demon Rite (a duel against your own Reflection: crossing re-crystallizes the Path, reaffirming is free, losing bites the soul) plus Rogue divergence; Li Xueye's tomb; and karma-scaled tribulation severity. The Vault requires Sect Library + Sealed Shelves ON. No migration.
feature_ftue_espinha_desc: The stitched first hour for new players.
feature_golpe_padrao: ⚔️ The Default Strike (the art that fires when you are not there)
feature_golpe_padrao_desc: When a duel round runs out and the player did not answer within 15 seconds, the engine fills their side — and until now it always filled it with the basic strike, the punch. Anyone who closed the mini-app fought bare-fisted, and the time passed without anything on their Path moving. A player asked for this (10/09): "in Arena, give option to set 'default' technique to use (instead of default regular attack). This can give the option to advance paths without having to wait each time the 3 minutes counter". With this switch on, the player picks ONCE which of their equipped arts fires at that moment, and it fires on its own. WHERE IT APPLIES: in EVERY fight, not only the arena. The automatic fill is a single piece of code serving the game's ten PvE duel families plus PvP; treating only the arena would leave dungeons and hunting on the old rule, and half a fix is worse than none. The choice belongs to the player and holds wherever the clock fires for them. THE THREE BRAKES, each with a reason: (1) a FORBIDDEN PATH art never fires on its own — it charges karma and YEARS OF LIFE per use, and an automatic cannot charge a price the player did not choose at that instant; it does not even appear in the list, and the screen says it was left out and why (hiding it in silence would be the dead end). (2) without combat qi at that moment, the basic strike fires — never refuse the round, because a refused round leaves the duel open forever, which was exactly the bug that locked 13 players out. (3) the art must be equipped in that fight. And every refusal is WRITTEN into the duel log with its reason: a silent automatic that does not do what it was told is the same wound as the "your queue expired" that said nothing. Migration 141 (new column, starts empty for everyone). With the switch off the engine returns the same basic strike as always without even touching the database, and the column is never read.
feature_iconografia_desc: The game's navigation stops speaking in system emoji. Measured 09/08 in the client: 194 distinct emoji, 1638 occurrences. The flaw is not that they are ugly — it is that they are not OURS and they change shape: an emoji is drawn by the device's font, so the pagoda on the Sect tab is three different illustrations on iPhone, Android and Windows, in three palettes nobody here chose. After the Warm Skin, the Card and the Cultivator built a language of warm ink and cinnabar, the bottom bar was still a set of colourful Apple pictograms. The risk has a name: Amazing Cultivation Simulator — a Chinese cultivation game — was read as "Chinese RimWorld" BECAUSE OF ITS UI. In come 40 drawn SVG marks, all on the same grid (24x24, stroke 1.6, round caps) and all in currentColor: the colour always comes from the place the mark lives in, exactly as the 朱砂 seal already did. It is not a CJK font, and that is a decision: the mini-app loads none, and at 19px the glyph falls back to the system font — that would be trading one set of someone else's pictograms for another. Reach: the 25 tab destinations (the bottom bar AND the desktop rail, which groups the SAME list), the 20 Home cards, the 6 equipment slots and 21 state sites (lock, incense for waiting, warning, yes/no, gift). This is also where the ✦ that still marked "equipped" on the classic artifact cell dies — literally the glyph the industry has used since 2023 to mean "AI-generated". Accessibility: the bottom bar only writes the ACTIVE slot's label, so with marks the other seven would be mute to a screen reader — which is why the flag ON adds aria-label to the button. It does NOT touch CATALOG emoji (beasts, pills, artifacts): those are content, and on the card they are the honest back of a piece with no art yet. Orthogonal to ui_v2, superficie_desktop, pele_quente, cena_cultivo and cartas. Pure re-render: turning it off returns every site to today's emoji, byte for byte. No migration, no player state. —— 09/09, THE REACH GREW (and the promise above was too small). Measured on the served game with every visual key on: the player still saw 160 emoji across 8 tabs, because this key only reached 9.2% of the occurrences. And 47 of them (29%) were FOUR in the header — which renders on every screen, so they cost 1x per screen you open; that is why the old symbols showed up "on any account", new or old: it never depended on the account. Now it also covers: the AVATAR (the gradient ball dies a third time, and this time in BOTH places — the header and the Profile now draw the same component instead of two copies that had already drifted apart in six values); the BELL; the REALM CHIP, which becomes typography — the realm name moves up to the large size and the layer is spelled out, because the pictogram repeated what the line below already said in words, and the only mark that could go there would be the 山 mountain, which in the bottom bar means Home; the WORLD BADGE, which becomes 界 (hanzi, not emoji: 68 already live in the mini-app i18n, they do not change shape between devices and they are a house choice); and the 5 HUBS of the ui_v2 bar, which had 0 of 5 marks while the tabs had 25 of 25. Plus one defect that only showed up by LOOKING: the marks in both bottom bars were drawn BLACK on a black bar — a <button> does not inherit the page colour and the mark is drawn in currentColor; 8 per screen, invisible, on every tab measured, and no test saw it because the guard asked whether the tab had a mark, never whether the stroke showed. After this: 128 visible emoji (from 160) and the header at ZERO. What stays out is counted and is a batch of its own: 1,326 literals in the long tail of tabs.js.
feature_item_vivo: 器 The Living Item (its photo, and rank you can see)
feature_item_vivo_desc: A piece stops being interchangeable. Three parts of one owner order (09/08: "swords, cards differentiated by tier… if I open the item in the bag, show its photo", and then, after looking: "sword images sometimes show and sometimes don't"). (1) THE PHOTO IN THE DETAIL: art for 51/51 artifacts already existed and was already served in the bag cell — it was the detail modal that never asked for it, drawing a 30px icon instead. Artifacts and pills now use the same PieceHero the beasts already had. (2) THE PHOTO EVERYWHERE (Law F-7): only 12 points of the client asked for art; the forge, the artifact workshop, refining, enchanting, the profile, the pill recipe and beast evolution each hand-drew an emoji. Now 21 screens show the piece, all through one component. A piece with no art (herbs, ores) still shows the honest card back — nothing gets worse anywhere. (3) THE THREE TIERS: the card looked identical for a grade-0 and a grade-8 piece. Now there is common (today's card), notable (the outline warms, the spine lights up) and celestial (corner brackets, a glow, and the art bleeds past its plate). This does NOT reopen the 09/05 decision: the spine still says HOW MUCH (measured), the ornament only says "this is rare" — the first is read, the second is merely felt. Three tiers, not nine, derived from the step's position on its own scale (p = i/(n-1); celestial ≥ .90, notable ≥ .60), never from a fixed list of names. Part (3) only shows with The Standard Card also on. No migration, no player state: turning it off restores exactly what ships today.
feature_jianghu: The Jiānghú 江湖 — NPCs with will (MV-8)
feature_jianghu_desc: ⚠️ LAUNCH-SERVER-BOUND. NPCs stop being statues with stats and start WANTING things. On each world beat (6h) a few pick a goal by utility — their soul comes from path/karma/house, and the world only breaks ties: 🚩 Marching (they really change continent — plaza, exploration and travel show them in the new place) · 🗡️ Hunting you · 📜 Collecting a contract · 🩸 Settling a blood debt (NPC vs NPC — the news that isn't about you). Plans are ANNOUNCED in the Chronicle: it is the SAME line that becomes your rumour, delayed by distance. CAST: only world-native NPCs (the 'echoes' of real players are rewritten every 6h and therefore never act). BUDGET: 3 actors per continent per beat, but only 2 announcements — most act in silence and are seen only by whoever is there (otherwise the Chronicle becomes a log). DEPENDENCIES: works alone, but the 🚩 Banner's mechanical overrides need 'Regional States' ON, and the ambush's reputation gate needs 'Reputation + Rival' ON — without them those parts stay narrative only, never broken. ZERO migration.
feature_legacy_caves_desc: TEC-4 — when a house seeks inheritance in the World Pulse (seek_inheritance), the tomb of one of the 5 legendary NPCs may open VISITABLE on the map for a while (env knobs: LGC_OPEN_CHANCE 0.20 · 1 active worldwide · LGC_GLOBAL_COOLDOWN_H 48 · LGC_TTL_H 72 · 70/30 drift · 7d pity). Entering = 1 duel vs the Echo of the Legacy (1 attempt per opening); victory always pays (stones + material + R5+ fragment); the unique art (ids 600-604) drops at LGC_ART_CHANCE 0.15 + guarantee on the LGC_PITY_CLEARS(3)rd clear. INDEPENDENT of tiandao_director (own sweep in the pulse). LAUNCH-SERVER-BOUND: new content — enable on a test world first.
feature_marca_do_tracado: 印记 Mark of the Tracing
feature_marca_do_tracado_desc: 印记 Mark of the Tracing — mastery PER FORMATION, counted in activations on the body (the cavern does not count). Three visible steps: 印 Stroke (50) longer duration · 沟 Groove (200) cheaper craft of that formation · 印记 Mark (1000) cosmetic title. It never touches buff power, never makes a formation permanent, and the title never grants a bonus. Switching formations costs the accumulated mastery — that is the dilemma, not a side effect.
feature_masmorra_unica_desc: ⚠️ LAUNCH-SERVER-BOUND: enabling this on a live world catches players already mid-run (on 27/07 there were 15 open runs and 2 players with 2 simultaneous ones) — they will meet the refusal on their next entry, with a Retreat button to leave without losing the bag. With an open run (floor > 0) in any dungeon, ENTERING another is refused, naming the dungeon and floor of the run in progress and offering the way out right there. Sweeping ANOTHER already-cleared dungeon stays free (a sweep is revisiting what you mastered, not an expedition); sweeping the very one you are inside is refused, because today that pays twice — the sweep hands over a full clear while the manual run keeps its own bag. It honours MV-1 geography: each gate is anchored to a continent and travel has a 4h cooldown, so being inside three dungeons on three continents contradicted the world. No env knobs: the rule is binary and the run in progress is always the lowest id (deterministic, so the exit button does not dance between requests). Best enabled alongside dungeons_regionais.
feature_o_mapa: 圖 The Map (a hub screen becomes a place)
feature_o_mapa_desc: A hub screen stops being a LIST and becomes a painted PLACE with doors you touch. This is not "putting a background image on the hub": it swaps the navigation mechanism, which is what the owner asked for (08/09: "I'm thinking of a full HUB with an image where the person clicks the temple or whatever. Not these crazy menus where you have to hunt from one side to the other"). What was there before: the Cavern antechamber drew five CSS ellipses, each with a 28px emoji in the middle — not one pixel of illustration — and tapping opened an accordion that revealed ANOTHER button ("Enter"): two taps to reach what one should reach. Now it is a painting of the cavern with five structures drawn on top of it, and one tap goes straight to the destination. HOW IT IS BUILT: in separate layers. The background is atmosphere only (rock, mist, light) and each door is its own art piece. That matters because regenerating art in Nivrael always writes a NEW file — if the doors were painted into the background while their positions lived in code, the day the art changed the map would start pointing at the wrong places with no test complaining. Separated, alignment belongs to the code, a new door does not force a repaint of the scene, and each door can be LIT or UNLIT without repainting anything. THE HONESTY: an unlit door is still a door. The Hall of someone who has not established a cavern yet shows dark and says "waiting" — but the tap is still there, leading to the screen where they can establish it. An empty place waiting, never a place that vanished (the same answer the 11 realms got). No destination is orphaned: the 5 destinations of the Cavern group have 5 doors, and a test goes red the day a destination is born without one. Every door is a real button, named for screen readers, Tab-reachable, with a visible focus ring. ⚠️ THIS FLAG REQUIRES "The Living Scroll" (ui_v2) TO BE ON — hub screens only exist there. Turning on only this one changes nothing on screen. ⚠️ IT IS 1 OF 4 SCENES: only the Cavern is drawn. Self, World and Scroll keep today's screen and are declared pending (the World one still has to decide how nine destinations fit in a 358px painting). Combat gets no scene by decision: it has a single destination, and a scene with one door is a door with a frame. No migration and no player state: turning it off returns exactly today's screen, byte for byte.
feature_pele_quente_desc: The WARM palette applied to the whole mini-app: the background stops being #06080f (dark blue, the default colour of every dashboard on earth) and becomes #0b0a0c (the warm black the /login door already proved), text stops being bluish-white and becomes aged paper, and the cold accent becomes 朱砂 (the cinnabar seal). The risk has a name: Amazing Cultivation Simulator — a Chinese cultivation game — was read as "Chinese RimWorld" BECAUSE OF ITS UI, with no game rule changed. Does NOT touch the 11 realm colours (game identity, not frame) or the shadows. Orthogonal to ui_v2 and superficie_desktop. Pure re-render: turning it off restores everything. No migration, no player state.
feature_profissoes_desc: 1 craft per player (Alchemist/Blacksmith/Physician) that BITES the engines: alchemy success, forge cost, healing. XP from what the player already does; consumes the 'Profession Speed' knob and talks to geography (MV-1) and reputation (MV-6). Includes the Imperial Market Report.
feature_progressao_visivel_desc: Aggregated Combat Power that always climbs + before→after on every advance.
feature_quests_vivas_desc: Storylets: quests that only exist when the world makes them true (place, regional state, active event, karma), offered through NPC encounters (plaza, travel arrival, explore). On = the quest is a consequence of the world. Works together with 'Tiandao Director' and 'Regional States': event/state requirements only become true with those enabled.
feature_reputacao_rival_desc: Per-continent reputation (one number the place FEELS: market discount, plaza reverence, scorn — decays while you are away) + the RIVAL: a defeated NPC may return stronger, quoting the defeat. Talks to storylets (priority offers for the revered, suppressed for the scorned, quests requiring a known name), bounties (+rep) and the Director's Tides (+rep). Best with tiandao_director and estados_regionais ON.
feature_superficie_desktop_desc: The same client gets its OWN desktop layout: navigation moves from the phone bottom bar to a 236px side rail with EVERY destination visible, and content stops being a 480px column centred on a 1920px screen. ⚠️ The cut is NOT window width: it requires a declared web surface (no initData — inside Telegram it is ALWAYS a phone, even on Telegram Desktop), width >= 1024 and a fine pointer (a landscape tablet clears 1024px and is still a finger). So even ON, nobody entering through Telegram feels anything — the reach is only /app in a wide browser tab. One client, one codebase. No migration.
feature_tempo_do_ceu: 天时 The Time of Heaven
feature_tempo_do_ceu_desc: 天时 The Time of Heaven — the sky gains a temper, and it decides WHEN you face the lightning. ONE sky for the whole world (not per continent: 216 of 239 players never left Línghé, so geography would reach 3 people a month), derived from the clock every 12h — no table, no migration, no new job. Three skies: 🌩️ Wrathful (+12% severity) · ⛅ Serene (exactly as today) · 🌫️ Veil of Clouds (-12%). It bites at a single point, the tribulation's power, so the preview and the roll always read the same number. And it is the only system in the game that states the FUTURE: the screen shows which sky comes next and in how many hours, so waiting is an informed choice and never a punishment. The sky cannot be bought or dispelled with jade. No migration.
feature_tiandao_director_desc: The Heavens spawn events with a place, a deadline and a consequence — Beast Tides and Meteors on the map. On = a world that moves.
feature_ui_v2_desc: The new mini-app shell (5 hubs, orb, map). On = every player in the world sees v2.

qc_1_forbidden_absorb_result: You devour the Qi others breathe. Your foundation swells — but something cold settles in your heart.
qc_1_hoard_result: You seal every thread of Qi within yourself. Progress is progress — none may fault you for it.
qc_1_share_qi_result: You channel your surplus Qi to a struggling disciple. He bows in gratitude — and the Heavens note your kindness.
qc_2_counterfeit: 🃏 Pass off flawed pills as perfect
qc_2_counterfeit_result: You sell refuse as masterwork. Gold flows easily — and your word rots a little.
qc_2_gift_pills: 🎁 Donate the pills to the infirmary
qc_2_gift_pills_result: You hand the pills to the sect's wounded. Fewer stones, but the elders' respect is worth more.
qc_2_sell_fair_result: You sell the pills honestly at market. Fair name, fair coin, and herbs in change.
qc_3_cripple_result: You crush your foe's meridians far past need. He will never forget — nor will the Heavens.
qc_3_honor_result: You fight with skill and honor. No tricks, no cruelty — only the art.
qc_3_mercy_result: You lower your blade and salute your foe. Mercy is the mark of true masters.
qc_5_capture_result: You bind the beast firmly but with care. An honest hunter's work.
qc_5_harvest_core_result: You slay the beast and tear out its still-warm core. Raw power, bought in blood.
qc_5_release_rare_result: You release the wounded spirit beast. It vanishes into the mist — and something in the world thanks you.
qc_602_cruelty_result: Your punishment echoes down the halls. The House fears you — and your soul cools a little.
qc_602_honor: Apply the Sect's law, without hatred
qc_602_honor_result: Just punishment, measured. The House sees a future Elder in you.
qc_602_mercy: Forgive the disciple and teach him
qc_602_mercy_result: You plead for the youth. The Elder nods, slowly. Mercy, too, is a Dao.
qc_612_expose: Expose and strip his rank before all
qc_612_expose_result: You tear the cloud emblem from his chest and proclaim his shame before the whole sect, seizing all that he stole. The storm made its example, but something cold settles in your conscience. You lose 20 karma, take 500 spirit-stones from the seized assets and gain 25 sect contribution.
qc_612_justice: Uphold the sect's law, without cruelty
qc_612_justice_result: You speak the law of Azure Cloud with neither anger nor softness, and the brother accepts the sentence as a cloud bends to the wind. The Elder descends from the heights and honors duty fulfilled above all. You gain 0 karma, 350 spirit-stones and 50 sect contribution.
qc_612_mercy: Forgive: compassion is the higher Dao
qc_612_mercy_result: You lower your blade and lift the fallen brother, recalling that the cloud covers the righteous and the wayward alike. The Elder bows his head in silent approval, and the sky feels lighter over Linghe. You gain 20 karma, 250 spirit-stones and 35 sect contribution.
qc_615_glory: Press the advantage and seize glory before all
qc_615_glory_result: You press while the prodigy reels and tear the victory free under the eyes of the whole arena; the name of the Eternal Flame burns again in the mouths that called it ash. The Elder nods, satisfied, and the Thousand Bloom swallow their laughter. The House rises once more, and the spectators fill your hands with spirit-stones for the spectacle.
qc_615_prudence: Hold back and spare the rival, preserve the House and its people
qc_615_prudence_result: You lower your guard and spare the fallen prodigy, recalling that a flame which devours all around it consumes itself first. The Elder closes his eyes with rare pride: no victory honors the House more than the wisdom of knowing when to hold, and it is this wisdom the Eternal Flame prizes above all. The Elders reward your judgment with spirit-stones and write your name high in the sect's records.
qc_615_ruthless: Crush the rival at any cost, no mercy
qc_615_ruthless_result: You burn the prodigy's qi core until his cultivation turns to cold ash, a flame snuffed out that may never light again. The Thousand Bloom fall silent with dread and pour spirit-stones at your feet to soothe your wrath, but something darkens within you, and the Elder turns his face away: there are fires that give light, and fires that leave only ruin behind. The karma of the House now carries the weight of what you did.
qc_618_expose: Expose and strip his rank before all
qc_618_expose_result: You drag him before the whole sect, tear his emblem and seize his assets as a cold example; he leaves broken, and the silence after is chill. The seized assets weigh heavy in your hand, yet a stain settles upon your own conscience as well.
qc_618_justice: Uphold the House law, neither cruel nor soft
qc_618_justice_result: You weigh the offense by the House's serene measure and impose the just penalty, not a grain more nor less. The Elders bow their heads: you served duty above feeling, and Jade Harmony rewards most the guardian who keeps the scales steady.
qc_618_mercy: Forgive: compassion is the higher Dao
qc_618_mercy_result: You lower your blade and extend your hand; he falls to his knees weeping black qi from his eyes, and the harmony slowly takes him back. The House murmurs that mercy too is balance, and your name shines the cleaner for it.
qc_621_expose: Expose and strip rank: let him be an example
qc_621_expose_result: You drag the brother before the whole House, tear off his emblem and seize his assets before the silent disciples, adding five hundred spirit-stones to the Mountain's coffers. Fear teaches quickly and the stone grows harder for it, yet the cold climbing your spine warns that something in your own heart has turned to stone as well, and not all granite returns to flesh.
qc_621_justice: Apply the House law, neither cruel nor soft
qc_621_justice_result: You impose the sentence the Mountain has always imposed: labor in the stone until the debt is paid, not one blow more, not one pardon less. Without wrath and without pity, only duty borne as granite bears its weight. The Elder hands you three hundred and fifty spirit-stones and carves your name into the granite, for the Iron House honors above all the one who serves duty without bending it.
qc_621_mercy: Forgive: even iron bends before it breaks
qc_621_mercy_result: You lift the fallen brother by the wrist and return him to his post, saying a coward who comes back to temper himself is worth more than a corpse that learns nothing. Only true strength can raise the weak rather than crush them. The Elder nods slowly and presses two hundred and fifty spirit-stones into your hand, for the Mountain remembers those who walk the higher Dao of compassion.
qc_624_expose: Publicly shame and strip rank; make an example
qc_624_expose_result: You drag the disciple before the whole House, strip his rank, and seize his assets under the cold gaze of the Elders. The example freezes the heart of all who watch, and the seized goods yield 500 spirit stones and 25 sect contribution; but cruelty stains your conscience, and your karma falls by 20.
qc_624_justice: Uphold the House's law evenly, without cruelty
qc_624_justice_result: You pronounce the sentence as ice pronounces winter: firm, without wrath, without excess mercy. Duty done without deviation is Frozen Peak's purest cultivation, and the Elders honor you with 350 spirit stones and 50 sect contribution; your karma remains untouched.
qc_624_mercy: Spare the transgressor; compassion is a higher Dao
qc_624_mercy_result: You lower your blade and offer the repentant disciple the chance to purge his fault in frozen meditation. The Peak learns that even ice yields rather than shatter; the Elders reward you with 250 spirit stones and 35 sect contribution, and your karma rises by 20.
qc_627_expose: Expose and strip his rank before all
qc_627_expose_result: You drag him to the courtyard and reveal his crime before the whole Sect, stripping his rank and seizing all the poison earned. The disciples fall into a frozen silence; you made the traitor an example, but something cold settles in your chest and stains your own conscience (karma -20, 500 spirit-stones in seized assets, +25 sect contribution).
qc_627_justice: Uphold the House's law in fair measure
qc_627_justice_result: You pronounce the sentence with neither cruelty nor softness, expelling him from the Sect as the Thousand Bloom code demands. The Elder nods gravely: no petal weighs more than another on the scale, and the House honors above all those who keep their duty (karma 0, 350 spirit-stones, +50 sect contribution).
qc_627_mercy: Spare him; mercy is the higher Dao
qc_627_mercy_result: You raise the bowed disciple and bind him to penitent meditation, for a broken root may yet bloom. The Elder smiles with damp eyes: the Thousand Bloom see in you the heart that cultivates life even in one who has failed (karma +20, 250 spirit-stones, +35 sect contribution).
qc_630_glory: Press the advantage and claim the glory
qc_630_glory_result: You tear the secrets free and vanish into the mist before the alarm, spilling no more blood than the duel demanded. The name of Silent Wind races through the sects of Yanshan and Iron Mountain wakes the poorer. The House grants you 450 spirit-stones and raises your contribution by 40, with neither stain nor virtue: only the renown of the one who strikes first.
qc_630_prudence: Stay the blade and preserve the House
qc_630_prudence_result: You lower the blade and let the envoy go, choosing the House and its people over a reckless win, for a wind that shows itself too soon loses a thousand mountains for one hill, and a corpse in the mist would only bring war to the gates. The Elders smile at wisdom few disciples ever cultivate. The House grants you 250 spirit-stones, raises your contribution by 50, and your karma rises by 15.
qc_630_ruthless: Win at any cost and crush the rival
qc_630_ruthless_result: You cross the line the Elders never speak aloud and silence the envoy for good, carrying secret and blood in the same mist. Iron Mountain will bleed for years, but something cold now sleeps in your chest, and the wind you are has grown a shade darker. The House grants you 550 spirit-stones and raises your contribution by only 25, while your karma plunges by 20.
qc_633_glory: Press the advantage and claim the glory
qc_633_glory_result: You surge forward without hesitation and tear victory free in full light; Azure Cloud gathers its own in silence as your name blazes on the lips of the Sect. The Elder nods: the Sun did not retreat, and neither did you. You receive four hundred and fifty spirit stones and your name rises forty points in the Sect's records.
qc_633_prudence: Stay your hand and spare the House its excess
qc_633_prudence_result: You lower your blade and leave the rival alive, for a reckless victory would cost the Blazing Sun more than the humiliation of Azure Cloud is worth. The Elder smiles with rare respect: true fire warms the House before it burns the enemy. Your karma rises fifteen, you receive two hundred and fifty spirit stones and fifty contribution points, for above all else the Sect prizes wisdom.
qc_633_ruthless: Crush the rival at any cost
qc_633_ruthless_result: You cross the line no judge of the Sun should ever cross and burn the rival down until nothing remains but cold ash and a warning. The victory is total, yet the star lends this light no warmth; it only consumes. Your karma falls twenty, you receive five hundred and fifty spirit stones and twenty-five contribution points, bought at a price your shadow will carry.
qc_636_restraint: Master the thirst and seal the treasure
qc_636_restraint_result: You shut the vault before it can devour you from within, a rare wisdom in a demon. Little gold reaches the House, yet the Elder lifts an eyebrow and carves your name deep: a devourer who knows when NOT to devour is worth more to the Depths than a thousand hungry mouths. Your standing before the House rises greatly.
qc_636_seize: Devour it all, damn the Heavens
qc_636_seize_result: You wrench the forbidden treasure for yourself and drink its price to the last drop; the gold pours into your spatial ring, but something within you darkens and goes cold. The Abyss smiles: it always knew you were its own, and Heaven merely turns its face away.
qc_636_share: Split the spoils with the House
qc_636_share_result: You split the spoils with the House and leave the Jade Harmony disciple to swallow their own rage empty-handed. Cold pragmatism, with no nobility in it: the Depths thrive when their devourers feed together, and your loyalty is carved in gold and in debt.
qc_6_glory_result: You pour all your power into the kill. The glory is yours, and yours alone.
qc_6_protect_result: You draw the colossus's fury away from the innocent. They live — and your name spreads through the villages.
qc_7_claim_spoils_result: You collect what you won by right. Clean victory, fair reward.
qc_7_humiliate_result: You grind the loser's honor before the crowd. They laugh with you — and fear you.
qc_7_spare_result: You offer a hand to your fallen rival. A foe spared may become an ally.

trib_heart_demon_tutorial:
👁️ *Heart Demon Tribulation — Tutorial*

Your deepest fears take form. The Demon tests whether your *actions* align with your *Dao*.

📜 *How it works*
• You'll answer *3 moral dilemmas*
• For each, pick the option aligned with your *dominant Dao law* (the law where you have the most fragments)
• Don't guess — the Demon senses contradiction

🌌 *Dao elements → correct answer*
  ⚡ *Lightning* → direct action, no hesitation
  🔥 *Fire* → power, ambition, seize what's yours
  🌿 *Wood* → compassion, preserve life
  ☯️ *Chaos* → balance, the middle path
  🪨 *Earth* → patience, purity

If you have not mastered any Dao law yet, follow the path of *balance* (☯️) by default.

🔮 *Perception matters*
With `realm × 50` Perception you see all *3 options*. Below that, only *2* — you may miss the correct one. Raise Perception via gear and Body Tempering.

📊 *Final score*
• `0/3` correct → always fail
• `1/3` → 50% success chance
• `2/3` → 80% success chance
• `3/3` → guaranteed pass

⚠️ *If you fail*
CB drops to 80% of your current realm threshold (or just 5% loss with 🛡️ Heavenly Shield Talisman) + 6h cooldown.

_Breathe. Read each dilemma. May your will be unbreakable._

feature_cultivador_jogavel_desc: Wave 1 of the cut: back to the cultivator, and meditate. The Cultivation tab stops opening on a wall of identical boxes and gains three parts. (1) THE SCENE: your name, your realm and what you are doing, with the figure beside it; and the three numbers — Vitality, Qi and Cultivation Base — each with current and maximum on separate lines, in full, never abbreviated. A real player's Qi measures 2.08× above capacity: the bar fills, a terminal mark appears and a line says how far past it went, instead of faking 100%. (2) THE MEDITATION CARD: the SEVEN practices as rows, with duration, cost (0 Qi spelled out) and what is missing to unlock each one. Until now the mini-app showed FOUR — Basic Dao (realm 5), Deep Dao (6) and Transcendent Dao (8) never reached this screen, even when unlocked. Each of the server's five refusals gets its own sentence, inside the card, with the selection preserved. (3) THE ARRIVAL: an error stops showing the server's raw word and says what happened and what to do — and an expired session offers the right door: the login in a browser, reopening from the bot on Telegram. Plus the anchors at the top (Who you are · Practice · Paths), which only appear when the section actually exists. Orthogonal to the other visual keys; with this one off the tab draws exactly what it draws today. No migration, no player state.
feature_a_obra_desc: The master key for the night of 15→16/09, when you left the game with Claude and Astra and went to sleep. Turn this one line on and everything arrives at once, instead of hunting for five keys. Today it brings the Cultivation screen with the skin from Astra's preview: the large name in Cormorant over your realm's landscape, whole numbers (no more “48.47B”), a thin thread instead of the thick bar, the Cultivation Base becoming the close of the progression — threshold, distance left and the breakthrough button together — and Meditation as an open section with all SEVEN practices listed (the mini-app showed four; Basic, Deep and Transcendent Dao never reached that screen, even when unlocked). Plus the recovery card that replaced the English word “unauthorized” on a screen with no button. It does NOT turn on the iconography, the warm skin or the illustrated figure — those stay your decision, world by world. No migration, no player state; turning it off restores exactly what was there.
